title: Chris Kelly's band: instruments and personnel
summary: Discussion of Chris Kelly's six-piece band, its clarinet, banjo and string bass, and whether he used a sax.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band

blocks.x: Remember how many pieces he had? He had six pieces. What's up? Coronet or trumpet was he? Used to play cornet at the time.
Clarinet, trombone? Yeah, clarinet, trombone. George Boyd used to play clarinet with him a while. Did George Boyd come here with him?
Yes. What chord instrument did he have? A banjo, a guitar, a piano, what? No, it's that banjo. Banjo.
Yeah. You ever see Chris with a tube? Yeah. Playing a tube in his band? Yeah, in his band. Did he ever use a tube in his band, or did he always use a string bass?

I can't remember. No, I think he always used a string bass. A string bass. I'm trying to think of the playing bass with him. I know Chester Lissart played with him for a while. And, uh, Charlie was playing the banjo. But what's Charlie's last name, I don't know. But he's dead now.
Is that Blind Charlie or something? No, no, I know Blind Charlie. I don't know if there was a Charlie Moore up or what? Yeah, I think it really was Charlie Moore.
He used to play with him. He left, he couldn't play any band, he started playing guitar.
Did Chris's band ever use a saxophone when you saw him over here? No. No. Always had a clarinet. You ever see Chris with a saxophone?
No, I never seen Chris with a saxophone.
She told me he used to use, he was in on saxophone. I don't know, everybody else says he always carried a clarinet.
Yeah, he always carried a clarinet.
Maybe just one or two times he carried a sax.
Oh yeah, maybe not. Why somebody plays with him like that? The only man who carried a sax out here, mostly was Sam Morgan. He was in the world, played sax with him a long time out there.
